title: Obtain approval before storing recognized songs

statement.en: Before storing recognized songs in iCloud, obtain the person's approval.
statement.ja: recognized songをiCloudへ保存する前に本人のapprovalを得る。

conditions: The app can store songs recognized with ShazamKit in the person's iCloud library.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable ShazamKit experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるShazamKitの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Stop recording as soon as possible

statement.en: Stop ShazamKit audio recording as soon as recognition sampling allows.
statement.ja: recognition sampleを取得でき次第ShazamKitのaudio recordingを停止する。

conditions: People granted microphone access for audio recognition.
Apply the separate privacy MUST that limits recording to the required sample duration.
